How registration works

The fee and team rules are shown before you confirm. Your spot is counted once payment is confirmed.

ChooseOpen a challenge and read the brief, fee and dates.
Solo or teamPick a format the challenge allows.
Check your teamTeams need 2 to 4 members.
PayConfirm the fee in rupees.
SubmitUpload before the deadline and track your status.
Team of 4 – valid. Add 2 to 4 people to continue. A team of 1 or 5 cannot register.
